response.rationale: The item is defective (defective == True) and not final sale (final_sale == False), so RET-020 applies (priority 90), which allows returns of defective items regardless of the standard window. This overrides RET-008 (priority 10), which would otherwise deny the return for being past 30 days. Final-sale (RET-012) does not apply since final_sale is False, and fraud/goodwill rules do not apply.
